summary.en: 破甲 for magpie: dsh-purge's prompt-injection layer as gateway middleware — operator-priority system prompt, boost tail block, refusal correction and thinking-tag stripping, for every agent behind one gateway.
summary.zh: 破甲 for magpie：把 dsh-purge 的提示词注入层做成网关中间件——操作者优先级系统提示词、boost 尾部强化段、拒绝检测加固与 think 标签剥离，一个网关下所有 agent 共享。
